title: Declaration Base Information Package — api
description: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

function.description: Code specifying the function of a document.

functionalReference.description: Identification of a specific information exchange.

type.description: Code specifying the name of a document.
type.x-wco-code-list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User codes

journey.description: Identification of the journey of a means of transport, for example voyage number, flight number, trip number.

identification.description: Identification of a single port of call or other location of the itinerary of a means of transport.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

arrival.description: Date and time of arrival at itinerary port of the means of transport.

departure.description: Date and time of departure at itinerary port of the means of transport.

function.description: Code specifying the type of the itinerary location.

items.description: Details related to the itinerary of the means of transport.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

identification.description: Identification of a document providing additional information.

issue.description: Date and time of issuing an additional document and when needed, signed or otherwise authenticated.

issueLocationName.description: Name of the location where a document was issued.

type.description: Code specifying the type of an additional document.
type.x-wco-code-list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User codes

items.description: Details related to additional documents as part of a declaration or as part of a response.

country.description: Code specifying the name of the country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.

countrySubDivision.description: Code specifying the name of a country subdivision.

line.description: Specification of the postal delivery point such as street and number or post office box.

postcode.description: Identification of the postal zone or address.

identification.description: Identification of a port or location of disembarkation.

items.description: Details related to the disembarkation location.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

description.description: Description of personal belongings in the possession of individual crew members or passengers which according to regulations in force at the location of arrival of a means of transport are dutiable or subject to prohibitions or restrictions.

quantity.description: Quantity specifying the number of  personal belongings in the possession of individual crew members or passengers which according to regulations in force at the place of arrival of a means of transport are dutiable or subject to prohibitions or restrictions.

identification.description: Identification of a port or location of embarkation.

items.description: Details related to the embarkation location.

familyName.description: Family name of a person as mentioned in an official document.

givenName.description: Given name of a person as mentioned in an official document.

designation.description: Job title or the rank of a person.

nationality.description: Code specifying the nationality of a person.

birth.description: Date and time an individual was born.

birthPlace.description: Name of the location where a person is or was born.

gender.description: Code specifying the gender of a person.

residenceCountry.description: Code specifying the country of residence of a person.

status.description: Code specifying the status of a person on board.
status.x-wco-code-list:
UN/EDIFACT code list 3035 
UN/EDIFACT code list 7365

informationVerified.description: Indicator if the information is verified (boolean).

expiration.description: Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate).

identification.description: Identification of the travel document by number.

issueLocation.description: Identification of the country or political entity issuing the travel document.

type.description: Code specifying the name of a travel document.
type.x-wco-code-list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User codes

items.description: Details related to the travel document (e.g. passport).
Details related to the person on board of a transport means.

type.description: Code specifying the type of person (Crew, Passenger, Stowaway, etc.).

quantity.description: Quantity specifying the total number of persons (passengers and crew, including the captain/master) on board of a means of transport.

items.description: Details related to the total number of persons (e.g. passengers, crew).
Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.

identification.description: Identification of a party providing the transport of goods between named points.

items.description: Details related to the party undertaking or arranging transport of goods between named points.

name.description: Name of the party who makes a declaration to an official body or - where legally permitted - in whose name, or on whose behalf, a declaration to an official body is made.

identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

type.description: Code specifying the type of communication address.
